.]] Character Bank Tab Bags (DNT) are the internal bank tabs for the Character Bank. They can, however, be opened via the command with the numbers 6-11 (such as /run OpenBag(6)) with 6 corresponding to the first bank tab and so on. If the player does not own the tab, using the command to open that tab will not do anything. See Account Bank Tab Bag (DNT) for the Warband Bank variant.
Charred Recipes are the remains of recipes that were removed from the game. They are not usable and can only be vendored for a small amount of money.

]] The Character Bank is a character-specific bank that provides personal storage space for items, accessible only by the individual character that owns it. There are six tabs available, each containing 98-slots, for a total of 588 slots. The first tab costs , then increasing to , , , , and , for a total of . Owning all six tabs awards the Safer Deposit achievement.

Chestguard of the Insatiable Vision is obtained from Horrific Visions Revisited. Explorer gear is obtained by completing a Horrific Vision with 0-4 objectives finished. Cheat Meal is awarded to players who defeat Forgeweaver Araz after feeding a Forged Echo to the Dark Singularity in the Manaforge Omega on Normal difficulty or higher. This is one of the criteria of Glory of the Omega Raider. Select one Arcane Echo add spawn and have a tank kite it away from the group. Do not let it die. At 100 energy, kite the echo through the big blue beam in the middle of the room. In the final intermission, other players need to drop their Void Manifestation adds near the echo and the tank should kite the echo over those adds. This turns the echo into a Void Forged Echo. Quickly kill it before the draw-in from the Dark Singularity pulls the raid off the platform.

Chief Engineer Ulzik is the creator of Incognitro, the Indecipherable Felcycle. Outside of Incognitro's description in the Mount Journal, Ulzik is referenced only in the Untitled Journal and Ratts' Journal, Page 317, which describe Ratts' attempts to locate him. The journal implies that he is a mo'arg, and that he hid Incognitro, or the means for acquiring it, in the Hidden Hatch in the Mechanar. The journal also suggests that he is responsible for a number of other World of Warcraft secrets, although none are specifically named. Ulzik is not known to be present in-game.

The Chittering Den is a kobold- and undercrawler- filled area in the Ringing Deeps. Located on the mid-eastern wall, the area is bordered by the Obsidian Hollow to the southwest, the Fetid Grotto, Shadowvein Point and the Shadowvein Extraction Site to the west, and the Warrens to the northwest. The lower part is home to friendly kobold grubtenders who raise domesticated jawcrawlers, but the area has been infested by undercrawlers that prey on both the kobolds and their grubs. The upper parts have been taken over by the Glumtooth Gang, cronies of the Candle King who are building an army of captured bugs for war with the Machine Speakers. The Chittering Caverns is an area located in Thaldraszus, north of Algeth'ar Academy and south of the Veiled Ossuary. With War Mode enabled, the area is a Free For All and Extermination (Thaldraszus) is sometimes available. It consists of several caverns filled with dead trees, sickly yellow plants, and pools of fetid water. Numerous animal burrows are present. Insect pupa hang from the stone ceilings above, likely belonging to either the beetles or the scythid that occupy the small caves in the area. Enormous dragon or proto-dragon bones are scattered around. During the War of the Scaleborn, the Primalists discovered a secret passage to Algeth'ar Academy in the nearby Drake Grotto. Sirigosa

Chreni is a bronze drakonid located south of the Coreway in Dornogal, as part of the Horrific Visions Revisited base camp. She serves as the heroic weaponsmith, selling Veteran 1 (ilvl 668) weapons in exchange for Displaced Corrupted Mementos after earning Symphony of Masks (revisited) by clearing with any five masks. She also sells the Enchanted Warbound Purifying Kit for 2000 mementos, turning any future Champion track drops in visions to Warbound instead of Bind on Pickup. Before patch 11.2.0, she sold Hero 4 (ilvl 658) weapons. Nearby are TickTak, who sells Explorer 2 (ilvl 645) versions of these same weapons, and Rhythferr, who sells Adventurer 1 (ilvl 655) versions.
